# ssp_site (Resource)

Onboards a site (NSX Manager, AVI, or SSP) to the SSP platform.

The onboarding workflow is asynchronous; the provider polls until the site reaches
READY state (up to 90 minutes).

Credentials in `site_connection_info` are **one-time use** — SSP never stores or
returns them. They are kept in Terraform state (encrypted) so that reconnect and
offboard operations can use them.

To adopt an existing site: `terraform import ssp_site.this <site-id>`.

Corresponds to `POST/GET/PUT/DELETE /ssp/sites`.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `desired_state` (String) Desired onboarding state: `ONBOARD` (full onboard), `PREPARE` (prechecks only), or `OFFBOARD`.
- `site_connection_info` (Attributes, Sensitive) Connection details for the site. Credentials are write-only (never returned by the API). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--site_connection_info))
- `site_name` (String) Name of the site. For NSX_MANAGER sites this must match the name configured on NSX and is immutable after creation.
- `site_type` (String) Site type: `NSX_MANAGER`, `AVI`, or `SSP`.

### Optional

- `force` (Boolean) When `true`, force-onboards the site even if references to another SSP instance remain on it.

### Read-Only

- `connection_status` (String) Current connection status between SSP and the site: `HEALTHY`, `UNHEALTHY`, or `UNKNOWN`.
- `current_state` (String) Current readiness state of the site: `READY`, `NOT_READY`, `INACTIVE`, or `UNKNOWN`.
- `id` (String) Unique UUID of the site assigned by SSP.
- `nsx_cluster_id` (String) NSX cluster ID of the site (NSX_MANAGER sites only).
- `nsx_version` (String) NSX software version reported by the site (NSX_MANAGER sites only).

<a id="nestedatt--site_connection_info"></a>

### Nested Schema for `site_connection_info`

Required:

- `certificate` (String, Sensitive) PEM-encoded TLS certificate for the site. Required for all operations — confirmed live: the API rejects onboard/reconnect without it (`"Username, Password, Certificate and DiscoveryHostname are required"`). Previously marked Optional, which let this requirement surface only as a runtime 400.
- `connection_type` (String) Connection method: `DYNAMIC` (single hostname) or `STATIC` (list of addresses).
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for the site. Required for onboard, reconnect, and offboard.
- `username` (String, Sensitive) Username for the site. Required for onboard and reconnect.

Optional:

- `host_addresses` (List of String) List of host addresses (IP or FQDN, optionally with port). Required for `STATIC` connections.
- `hostname` (String) Hostname or IP of the site. Required for `DYNAMIC` connections.
